issues.on_page: Culture and recreation: Total Governmental Funds column 173,111; Park Fund column 173,117
issues.issue: Answer to the Hickman question: the Total column prints 173,111, which the extraction records correctly. The Park Fund column (the only fund with this line) prints 173,117. The printed totals tie only with 173,117: Total expenditures 2,446,376 and Park Fund total 324,176 (173,117 + 151,059). So 173,111 is a print error in the report's Total column. The extraction keeps the printed figure and records the 6 difference in report_discrepancies, which is the right handling. The Park detail line (detail[31]) correctly uses 173,117.

One label gets different categories across the report: governmental statement and Street detail use intergovernmental/state aid, Park and Reading Center detail use donations/contributions, and business-type receipts[12] (Water 188,000) uses donations/contributions. The grantor is never printed. The rules ask for the same category for the same label within a report.
